attestations.text: Mongol Sirut 西魯特 clan which was settled in the Korchin district. His father Bobotu 博博圖 brought a group of fellow-tribesmen to join Nurhaci [q. v.] and was later made captain of a company (niru ejen) under the Mongol Plain White Banner.
